subject: project-genesis timed budget (p95 <= 100 ms) under the global pre-warm methodology
authority: PM-Agent-01 ruling (owner-revisable): land the pre-warm methodology on its merit; both runs preserved; neither is the genesis p95 acceptance number; authoritative near-budget timed acceptance deferred to the serial S6 candidate proof.

runs.note: Idle-window run that PREDATES the pre-warm. Establishes steady-state genesis is comfortably within budget absent contention; it is NOT the acceptance number precisely because it predates the pre-warm methodology.
runs.observation: Steady-state trials 35-46 ms (2-3x under the 100 ms budget); the single over-budget value is the first-ever cold trial0 (107.2 ms), the cold-start characteristic the pre-warm addresses. Retained and disclosed, never re-rolled.

runs.classification: environment-control report per GLOBAL_PREFERENCES_PRODUCTION_ACCEPTANCE_CONTRACT.md measurement-protocol section (line 223: no concurrent builds/jobs; inability to control the environment is reported). NOT a budget failure and NOT acceptance evidence.

competing_load.context: Run executed immediately after a concurrent datum-gui release build (6m57s) plus two ~90s GUI diagnostic launches on the shared KDE desktop; cache eviction and residual load inflated the fork/IO-heavy genesis path.

runs.observation: Genesis 99-113 ms across all trials with a 993 ms stall, while the non-near-budget project-validation stayed stable (~27-29 ms). The pre-warm still reduced cold trial0 (107 -> 99.5 ms even under load). The overage is competing load, not the budget or the methodology.

methodology_landed: Global pre-warm (measurements_producer.prewarm(); datum.preferences.measurement-prewarm.v1 provenance) + the contract measurement-protocol clause sanctioning it; it reduces first-ever cold start and is recorded so the corpus states measurements reflect steady state.
s6_protocol_note: PM-Agent-01 will enforce a floor-wide quiet window at candidate-proof time: all agents idle, no builds, no GUI runs, a single measurement process. This is the controlled environment the contract's env clause requires for genesis and every other near-budget timed budget (release-query/durable/project and the native GUI budgets).
not_retry_to_green: Two runs, both preserved, neither cherry-picked. The clean run predates the pre-warm so it is not the acceptance number; the contended run is an environment report, not a pass. No run was repeated to obtain a passing value.
